verdict.rationale: Linear documents first-party native integrations for GitHub (PR workflow automation, issue sync, review assignment to GitHub teams, opening synced issues in GitHub) and Slack (create issues from messages, synced threads, notifications, agent reads linked channels and posts updates). Its integration directory also lists many other common tools such as Figma, Notion, Datadog, Salesforce and Jira import. Missing for 10: any evidence of a Google Drive integration, and independent or hands-on corroboration of how well the integrations work.
